newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms seek 21,500T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms seek 21,500T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have jointly invited tenders to buy a total of 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Wednesday, traders said on Tuesday.
Of the total, Cheiljedang has invited tenders for 12,000 tonnes at basis prices over July futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges, including the Chicago Board of Trade, traders said.
Dongah Flour has invited the remaining 9,500 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for May 5-June 5 to the western port of Inchon.
